primary_identity_evidence.primary_identity_description: MLE-15 is described as a modular lytic enzyme composed of cecropin A (OMP), linker 2, CBD of endolysin 201phi2-1, and EAD Ph2119; it was assigned as the lead variant after preliminary growth-inhibitory screening.
terminal_or_tag_notes: The primary Table 1 sequence is 304 aa and ends with GKKYHHHHHH.
The methods/results describe purification through a C-terminal His-tag; this tag is encoded in the reported sequence, not a separate chemical modification in the candidate row.
No D-amino acid, cyclization, disulfide, amidation, lipidation, or terminal chemical cap is reported for MLE-15 in the checked packet materials.
primary_identity_evidence.expression_or_production_context: MLE-15 was overexpressed in E. coli BL21(DE3) pRIL from recombinant plasmid pVTD-MLE-15 and purified by metal affinity chromatography through its C-terminal His-tag.
